integrity: The theorem is proved algebraically from the published first-step formulas and strong-Wolfe inequalities. The bundled rational-arithmetic replay checks representative cases only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the first update on a scalar strictly convex quadratic and the source initialization \(d_0=-g_0\); it does not characterize later higher-dimensional iterations.

The finding concerns failure of the convex-combination mechanism to realize the stated conjugacy target; it does not assert divergence or disprove the source's sufficient-descent or convergence conclusions.
The exact line-search case \(a\alpha_0=1\) reaches zero gradient and is terminal rather than a counterexample.
title: Convex NVHS*-CD hybridization cannot realize conjugacy on a scalar quadratic under inexact strong Wolfe steps
